variables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Server-owned zero-cost OpenRouter route. Separate from OPENROUTER_KEY.

variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Gemini API credential, also used by the Gemini image generation tool.

variables.name: CEREBRAS_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Cerebras Inference credential. Trial credit is not treated as a free route.

variables.name: GROQ_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Groq credential. The account tier is not exposed, so free-tier use is unverified.

variables.name: OPENCODEAI_API_KEY
variables.purpose: OpenCode Zen credential. Zen is billed per request.

variables.name: APINEX_KEY
variables.purpose: APInex credential. Its daily allowance requires a paid top-up.

variables.name: FREEAI_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Free.ai credential. Usage beyond the daily pool is billed.

variables.name: HMS_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Canonical 100MillionSeek credential documented by the provider.
variables.legacyNote: 100MILLIONSEEK_API_KEY starts with a digit and cannot be exported by a POSIX shell. It is accepted only when a non-shell environment injects it.

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Cloudflare API token used for Workers AI calls.

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.purpose: Cloudflare account identifier used to build the Workers AI URL. Not a secret, but still server-only.

variables.name: VERCEL_KEY
variables.purpose: Deployment authentication only. Never forwarded to an AI gateway.
